data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate has also seen improvement in its prior year reserves for 2021 & 2022, due to good experience on its longer tail and Specialty classes.

named_events.loss_description: The level of insured global catastrophe in 2024 has totalled ~$140bn according to Munich Re's research division. This is the fifth most costly year since 1980. $47bn of this was due to US hurricane, although through a number of events rather than one single large event.
The Marine and Specialty portfolio continued to also see some positive rate change post the Baltimore bridge collision.

On the 7 January 2025, a series of devastating wildfires started in Los Angeles, which quickly spiralled out of control due to drought conditions and strong winds. The event is expected to trigger material losses to Syndicate 6117 and considering the uncertainty involved, a reliable estimate of the associated outflows cannot be made.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 were GBP 60.337m. During 2024 gross prior-year provisions were reduced by GBP 5.786m (a c.9.59% release), driven by favourable claims experience on longer-tail business and Specialty classes. The release is explicitly reported in the technical provisions reconciliation. The Syndicate nevertheless experienced significant 2024 catastrophe activity (notably US hurricanes) which impacted current year results; a material post-balance-sheet wildfire in January 2025 is expected to give rise to losses but is not reflected in these reserves.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' comparative (31 December 2023). Prior year development taken from 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' in technical provisions note (gross, GBP 000). All primary figures in the accounts are presented in GBP 000; monetary fields above converted to millions. Named events are reported where mentioned; most event impacts are not quantified for Syndicate 6117. Claims development triangle is limited in scope (only UW years 2022-2024) and RITC activity for the 2022 closed year is noted in the underwriting year accounts which may affect interpretation of development for that year.
